remarks:
Just minutes south of Fredonia town center, this spectacular property offers a rare blend of privacy, natural beauty, and limitless potential. Whether you envision building your dream home, developing a multi-home retreat, or creating a private cabin or campground getaway, this property provides the perfect canvas.
A custom gated and fenced entrance welcomes you in, leading to over four miles of well-maintained stone roads that wind through the property to a serene one-acre pond. Positioned for breathtaking eastern exposure, the pond captures stunning morning sunrises and creates a peaceful, picturesque setting.
Along the western boundary, Canadaway Creek flows through the land—known for rainbow, brown, and brook trout. Significant professional improvements have already been made, enhancing accessibility and usability while preserving the property’s quiet, secluded feel. Overlooking the pond is a charming cottage equipped with electric, well, and septic. Inside, you’ll find a cozy kitchenette, bedroom, and loft, while the outdoor deck offers the perfect spot for relaxing, and enjoying peaceful waterfront views. The pond itself has the potential to be expanded to approximately six acres, offering even greater possibilities.
Two large barns provide ample space for equipment, ATVs, tools, and storage, making the property ideal for both recreation and practical use. Known for excellent hunting, and strategically placed food plots and elevated blinds, offering opportunities to pursue trophy whitetail. Rolling terrain, open agricultural fields, and maintained clearings create multiple ideal building sites, many with scenic views. With electric and internet available at the road and frontage along Fredonia-Stockton Road and CR 60, accessibility and infrastructure are already in place. This is a truly unique opportunity to own a private, near turnkey recreational and residential property with versatility in a highly desirable location., all of your conveniences are close by.
